failure_modes: If realized landmark_00_local_dx over t≈0.15-0.30 does not differ from the M2 baseline beyond batch noise, H002 is falsified and the middle-emphasis dose is not supported.

The curve has 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches, so the aggregate middle trough may not be a stable per-batch direction; the dose may act on a non-reproducible feature.

Equal time-integrated dose ratios do not guarantee equal physical displacement: per-seed flow magnitude, gradient cancellation, dose caps and clash backtracking can differ, so requested dose must be audited against delivered dose in traces.
Only one of 200 curve features was inspected; other coordinate features may respond differently or adversely to middle emphasis.

No decoded final affinity or survival outcome is available in this role input, so improved affinity cannot be claimed; if final predicted affinity or structural validity degrades despite verified dose delivery, the edit should be reverted.
The coordinate proxy is untyped and carries no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation, so no affinity mechanism is asserted.
result.rationale: H002 is the only hypothesis whose scope matches the strongest reproducible structure in the delivered curve: landmark_00_local_dx reaches its most negative excursion near t≈0.18-0.20, inside the middle observed score nodes (t≈0.15-0.30), whereas the early rise and late recovery are near-zero and the whole-window endpoint contrast is weak (z=-0.18). W2_middle_peak is a registered dose recipe that concentrates the ratio budget on the middle knot (dose [0.5,1.5,0.5]) while preserving the M2 reward family, delta, teachers, mixture temperature and frozen eta, so it is the offered intervention that acts on the observed middle-window coordinate response without extrapolating beyond the observed score nodes. W1_early_soft and W3_early_strong_control emphasize the early phase, which the evidence shows is a near-zero-to-peak rise rather than the largest coordinate excursion, and W3 is the opposite time-order control.
